title: At the upper bound
bestSource: Each contact uses a free side of two H’s. The two end H’s have two free sides and the other four have one: eight in all, so at most 4 contacts. The solution has 4.
intro: The upper bound is 4 contacts. Up to rotations and reflections, one fold reaches it.
hint: The two end H’s each touch two H’s; every other H touches one.
